name: Dornarius
backstory: Child of Dornakus and Fenrius in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside sits at the square's edge through petition days,..., having heard about Birth Of Fenrius.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Nakus has died.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Nakus, named Dorakus.
Heard that Dornakus and Doraknus now have a child, Dornaknis.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Terfila their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Terfila as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: sits at the square's edge taking down claims, checks each one against the standing record, and quietly keeps her own notes on the disputes that keep coming back

arc.premise: Dornarius has stopped just filing Terfila's trade complaints and started tracking down the actual goods owed - chasing the physical shipments still sitting undelivered rather than adding another name to the register.
